actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This sounds like a great project and well within my area of experience (real-time visualizations, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive layouts and dark mode). My portfolio: jordanmitchell.dev and I can share relevant examples or code samples on request.

A few quick questions to scope this properly:
1) Do you have an existing API spec or sandbox I can review (rate limits, auth, available endpoints)?
2) For “real-time” updates, do you prefer WebSockets/Server-Sent Events, or should we poll the REST API? Any preferences on charting libraries (you mentioned D3.js — are you open to Recharts/Visx/Chart.js if they speed development)?
3) What user roles and permissions do you need (e.g., admin, viewer, read-only analytics)?
4) Do you have design assets or a style guide for the dashboard, or should I produce UI mockups first?
5) Is the $5k–$6k budget firm for the full scope you listed, or is there flexibility for phased delivery?

I’m available to start next month and can carve out time for a 30–45 minute call this week to discuss details and timelines. My general availability next week is Tues–Thurs afternoons (CT). Let me know what works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer
jordanmitchell.dev
